relationships.subject: PTGS2/COX2
relationships.evidence_quote: The main product derived from PTGS2/COX2 expression and activation is Prostaglandin E2 (PGE2)

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of this receptor in beta cells by PGE2 binding was associated with beta cell dysfunction and apoptosis 52, 54.

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: This phenotype appeared to be facilitated by PGE2-mediated inhibition of NF-κB, therefore decreasing the pro inflammatory cytokines production 27.

key_findings: Review: the PTGS2/COX2-PGE2 axis has context-dependent pro- or anti-inflammatory effects, with outcomes in beta cells depending on which EP receptor mediates PGE2 action.
EP3 activation is detrimental to beta cells whereas EP4 (and EP1) activation promotes survival.
